name: SHOCO token (reflection deliver()+skim exploit) - bot tx at block position 0, attacker tx at position 15 reverted
verdict_reason: Bot EOA 0xE71A... (different address, same block, position 0) executed the same victim-call pattern as the attacker's reverted tx 0x2f2c3c1c (position 15): router swap WETH->SHOCO on pair 0x806b6c68, SHOCO.deliver(uint256) (0x3bd5d173), pair.skim(address) (0xbc25cf77), WETH->ETH. Adapted not verbatim (self-funded 1.4676 ETH instead of Balancer flash loan; 12 pair.skim rounds with 19 deliver() calls of different amounts). Local anvil fork at block 16440978: attacker tx alone SUCCEEDS and nets 4.158888932826055 ETH; bot tx first then attacker tx reproduces the revert; bot's gross WETH->ETH gain is identical to the wei (4.158888932826055 ETH) to what the attacker's tx would have captured. Ordering: bot tx at index 0 vs attacker at 15; bot paid 0.0921 ETH via coinbase transfer (effective gas price 15.61 gwei < attacker's 16.61 gwei, so the bot was not ordered by gas price -> bundle-like placement, inferred). In-block evidence only (no mempool archive for 2023-01-19); whether the bot saw the attacker's pending tx or independently found the bug from the attack contract deployed 4 minutes earlier (block 16440959) is not knowable.
era: 2022-23 post-Merge, MEV-boost (Flashbots relay bids available; no mempool archive: in-block evidence only)
protocol_loss_note: 4.158888932826055 ETH drained from the SHOCO/WETH Uniswap V2 pair (all of it captured by the bot; USD not computed, ETH was roughly $1.5-1.6k on 2023-01-19 -> ~$6.5k, approximate and not sourced)

headline_text: At block 16440979 a generic searcher bot (index 0, 0.092 ETH coinbase) ran the SHOCO deliver/skim exploit calls ahead of the attacker's tx (index 15, reverted) and kept 4.1589 ETH gross, about 4.05 ETH net. Fork replay: the attacker alone would have got the same 4.1589 ETH.

harmonized.verdict_reason: Bot idx 0 vs attacker idx 15 in the same block; the same victim calls adapted (not byte-copied); bot gain equals the attacker's counterfactual gain to the wei; the attacker's tx reverted.
harmonized.headline_note: Calls adapted rather than copied; whether the bot saw the pending tx or the deployed contract is unknowable (in-block evidence only).
